labels.label: defi:BTZtop

hypotheses.paper: Delta a lightlike line of E^{1,2}
hypotheses.note: AUDIT-1 fix: the definition is now given for every lightlike line (GX.IsBTZLightlikeLine Delta: Delta = p0 + R w, w != 0 null; GX.btzLineTop Delta on GX.BTZLineJplus Delta = J+(Delta)). It is stated intrinsically for every subset Delta of M3, the half-ray being ]p,+inf[ := Delta n J+(p) \ {p} (GX.btzLineRay); on a lightlike line this is the relatively open future half-ray {p + sigma w : sigma > 0}, w its future null direction (GX.IsBTZLightlikeLine.exists_future, GX.btzLineRay_eq, GX.IsBTZLightlikeLine.btzLineRay_eq). The BTZ-model line btzLine x0 = x0 + R u is a specialisation: GX.isBTZLightlikeLine_btzLine, GX.btzLineRay_btzLine (ray = btzRay p), GX.btzJTop_eq_btzLineTop (btzJTop x0 = btzLineTop (btzLine x0), BTZJplus x0 being BTZLineJplus (btzLine x0) by definition)

hypotheses.paper: generated by the induced topology and the sets I+(p) u ]p,+inf[, p in Delta
hypotheses.note: btzLineTop Delta = induced ⊓ generateFrom (btzLineGen Delta) (mathlib order: the coarsest topology finer than both); GX.btzLineTop_le_iff is the universal property; GX.btzLineGenSet_subset: the generators lie in J+(Delta); GX.isOpen_btzLine_gen: they are open. The same for the specialisation (btzJTop_le_iff, btzJGenSet_subset, isOpen_btzJ_gen)

findings: The definition is consistent with its motivation (l.2279): the BTZ topology is exactly the image by D of T_BTZ (GX.btzJTop_eq_coinduced, from GX.btzJDevHomeomorph); D^{-1}(I+(p_s) u ]p_s,+inf[) = {s < t + kappa r} with kappa = -nullQ(v)/<v|u> (GX.btzDevM_mem_genSet_iff).

hypotheses.paper: E_0 = BTZ model with its structure, D, Gamma (l.2237-2250)
hypotheses.note: every x0, every v with <v|u> < 0, every alpha != 0 (Model's BTZModel alpha with IsBTZStructure x0 v alpha); the paper's instance alpha = 2pi, x0 = 0, v = (-1,1,0) is GX.btzE0_quotient_chart. hypotheses.paper: the singular E^{1,2}-structure of Gamma\J+(Delta) (not stated)
hypotheses.note: the quotient structure (prop:aeGXquotient, existsUnique_aeGXQuotient) of the structure of J+(Delta) developed by the inclusion on J+(Delta)\Delta (devStructure); it is the unique maximal a.e. atlas making the projection an a.e. morphism (GX.btzJQuot_existsUnique)

a homeomorphism which is an a.e. (Isom(M3),M3)-morphism, and so is its inverse (rem:composition_morphisms_morphisms_category); AUDIT-1 fix: Gamma\J+(Delta) is T2, locally path-connected AND second countable (GX.btzJQuot_instances), so both sides are objects of SingGXCat (GX.btzModelObj, GX.btzJQuotObj) and D-bar is an isomorphism there (GX.btzQuotChartIso, via SingGXCat.isoOfHomeomorph)

findings: No proof is printed (the ledger row is 'open'). The proof here: D : (cylinder, T_BTZ) -> (J+(Delta), BTZ) is a homeomorphism (GX.btzJDevHomeomorph): continuity because D^{-1}(I+(p_s) u ]p_s,+inf[) = {s < t + kappa r} is naturally open; openness at the axis from the estimate GX.btz_axis_diamond (the set I-(P_eta) n (I+(p_{t-eta}) u ]p_{t-eta},+inf[) pulls back into the horn neighbourhood {r(1+theta^2) < eps, |t'-t| < eps}); D is Gamma-equivariant and T_BTZ induces the quotient topology of E_0 (coinduced_orbitMk_tamTop), so D-bar is a homeomorphism; on regular parts both charts are translates of D.
With the BTZ topology Gamma\J+(Delta) is Hausdorff (GX.btzJQuot_instances), in contrast with the quotient of the usual topology (l.2273).
questions: The paper does not say which singular E^{1,2}-structure Gamma\J+(Delta) carries; the quotient of the structure developed by the inclusion J+(Delta)\Delta -> E^{1,2} is taken (the only natural one, and unique by prop:aeGXquotient). Confirm this is the intended structure.

hypotheses.note: the cylinder model with hornTop (= Model's T_BTZ, btzTop_eq); AUDIT-1 fix: on the maximal branched cover itself, GX.btz_tamifying_topology_generated_open_cover now takes Phi lifting the projection (orbitMk o Phi = base) and the BTZ-structure hypotheses, and proves Phi^* hornTop is the cover's tamifying topology (btz_isTamifyingTopology), D o Phi its developing map over the regular part (btz_isRegDevelopingOnReg), and the generation by T_BTZ-open diamonds of the (D o Phi)-order. hypotheses.paper: J^-(p), J^+(q) for p, q in BTZ-tilde (not defined in the paper)
hypotheses.note: y <= y' iff D(y) <= D(y') in E^{1,2} (GX.btzCylLe), D the developing map, injective onto J+(Delta): the cover analogue of GX.E0.Le ('developments differing by a future causal vector, winding free')

findings: No proof is printed. True at every point, BTZ points included: off the axis the diamond J-(D y + eta e) n J+(D y - eta e), e = (1,1,0) in null coordinates, lies in the null box of radius 2 eta; at an axis point (apex,t) the diamond J-(P_eta) n J+((apex, t-eta)), P_eta = x0 + (t+eta, eta, 0), lies in the horn neighbourhood and its T_BTZ-interior contains I-(P_eta) n {t-eta < t' + kappa r} (GX.btz_exists_diamond).
questions: The causal order on BTZ-tilde is not defined in the paper (l.2313 says causal notions 'extend naturally'). Reading taken: y <= y' iff D(y) <= D(y') in E^{1,2} (D injective onto J+(Delta)). Accept this reading (the row would then close), or require the order from T_BTZ-continuous causal curves (then the equivalence with the D-pullback order is owed)?

kb_proposals: A `set T := (t : TopologicalSpace X)` in a proof makes T a LOCAL INSTANCE: every later lemma whose instance argument is synthesized picks T and fails with 'synthesized instance not defeq'. Write the topology out, or use `have hT : T = …`.

With a non-instance topology (hornTop), `Homeomorph.continuous`, `IsOpen.preimage`, `IsOpen.mem_nhds` all re-synthesize the instance and fail; use the raw continuity lemmas or `@IsOpen.mem_nhds _ t _ _ h hx`.

A type synonym `def BTZJplus := {q // …}` with its own TopologicalSpace instance (an inf of induced and generateFrom) and its own MulAction lets `Orbits Γ BTZJplus` carry the right quotient topology with no instance clash; nhds of the instance is obtained by a `calc … := rfl` step to the inf, then `@nhds_inf _ t₁ t₂ q` with explicit topologies.
